ATTRIBUTION IS DECIDED PER ASSERTION, not per scenario (§8 Q12, frozen 2026-09-16 before any evidence under it existed): a scenario may carry both an SL-14 expectation and an SL-4-era one, and gating the second because the first is present made this Slice answerable for behavior SA-14.1 forbids it to change.
